_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The 3% directional-move rate over 7 days makes HOLD the statistically honest call in a coil, and neither brain has confirmed the institutional-return signal that would break this stalemate upward.
next_move.brains_agree: Split — analyst forward-calls Disbelief with HOLD direction (medium conviction, conditional on ETF/funding/VIX confirmation); narrative writer implies UP direction toward Hope/Optimism based on the bottom analog — they agree on the pattern but disagree on whether current divergences invalidate the bullish read
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows turn positive with funding dropping below 40 and VIX retreating below 50 — institutional return with retail fear matching the bottom_2024_aug recipe
